4. World Almanac/NPCs/Lady Fiona Wachter.text: Fiona Wachter openly admitted her allegiance to Strahd.
Fiona Wachter wanted to rule Vallaki, saying the town needed a new direction away from the Vallakovichs.

4. World Almanac/Settlements/Vallaki.md.text: Fiona Wachter took power in Vallaki with the party's reluctant consent.

4. World Almanac/Places of Interest/Van.text: An abandoned, colourful wagon full of monster-hunting gear stood outside the tower.
The tower's former owner, Khazan, was trapped and driven mad in a grim dimension behind a hidden door until the party defeated him.

4. World Almanac/Items/Khazan's Wand of.text: The wand can manipulate and repair the structure of the tower.
Used at growing strength, the wand revealed a hidden door in the tower.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Strahd Von Zarovic.text: Strahd's homeland was the kingdom of Mauristatia.
Strahd's childhood was in the year 473.
As a boy, Strahd felt his family's pressure, and a younger sibling was on the way.
Strahd's army fought the Order of the Silver Dragon at the village of Zmei.
Delus was a commander in Strahd's army.

4. World Almanac/Regions/Barovia.md.text: Many Barovians have no souls; souls in Barovia are reborn into new bodies.

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Ezmerelda Davenir.text: Ezmerelda is searching for her mentor, Rudolph van Richten.
Ezmerelda tried to assassinate Strahd and failed.
Ezmerelda knows the cure for lycanthropy: wolfsbane, the ground heart of the werewolf that bit the victim, and fiend's chilli from the slopes of Mt. Ghakis.
4. World Almanac/NPCs/Ezmerelda Davenir.learned: S15 The Seige of the Werewolves

4. World Almanac/NPCs/Rictavio (COS).md.text: Rictavio killed Yan, a Vistani whose preserved head was kept in the tower.

4. World Almanac/Deities/Dark Powers of.text: Marin accepted power from the Dark Powers to bring Yan's head to life permanently.
